properties.description: Count the Capabilities each registered Artifact realizes and name those that are distributional outliers within this design, with the arithmetic and both cutoffs attached. It reports a fact and refuses a verdict: no severity, no suggested fix, and no claim about size — an artifact of any length realizing one capability is silent here. Because the comparison is against this design's own spread, a uniformly coarse early-phase design produces no finding, which is what keeps the reading from punishing correct function-first work.
properties.name: Report where the build does not separate what the design separates
